title: Continuing Education
description: Continuing education, courses, and lifelong-learning resources at the University of Toronto.

sections.title: School of Continuing Studies
intro: The University of Toronto School of Continuing Studies is the primary hub for lifelong learning at UofT, offering a wide range of courses and certificate programs across various fields, including business, arts, health, and technology.

blocks.body: Explore our comprehensive range of professional development courses and certificate programs.
Discover financial aid opportunities to support your continuing education journey.
Pre-university summer technology programs designed specifically for teenagers.
